newsitem.title: USA: Buckle Q4 same store sales up 6.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Buckle Q4 same store sales up 6.1 pct.

text.p: The Buckle Inc, which reported higher fiscal 1996 fourth quarter earnings, said Tuesday comparable store sales for the period rose 6.1 percent over the same quarter a year ago.

Net income for its fourth quarter ended February 1, 1997 rose 25 percent to $5.5 million or $0.75 a share on 7.3 million shares outstanding, compared with $4.4 million or $0.62 on 7.0 million shares outstanding a year earlier.
Net sales for the fourth quarter rose to $62.1 million from $56.5 million for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1995.

A year ago, the fourth quarter was a fourteen week period compared with thirteen weeks in the fiscal 1996 fourth quarter. Net sales for the thirteen weeks ended February 1, 1997 compared with the same thirteen week period a year ago increased 16.2 percent.
Comparable store sales increased 6.1 percent for the thirteen weeks ended February 1, 1997 compared with the thirteen weeks ended February 3, 1996.
Buckle currently operates 182 apparel stores in 22 states.
